experiments.limitations: No Gemini / model API / ToolBench / original DFS / SFT / BFCL. Answer-first always generates reachable tasks, DFS written locally; 500/500 cannot establish comparative ToolGrad benefit; time CPU RSS not feature-equivalent.

experiments.scope: Real pinned gpt-6-astra via Codex 0.164.0, 5 x2 ephemeral disposable Git coding tasks; both 5/5 semantic correct, 4/5 strict workspace clean due identical Python pycache; B -46.72% input tokens and -13% wall, lower tokens 5/5 faster 4/5. Independent post-hoc file/state tests.
experiments.limitations: N=5 pairs one run each, combined AGENTS+skill descriptions and body treatment, intentionally weak verbose A, no real agent repo/model variants, cache/server confounding; API list-price equivalent not actual billed Codex charges.

experiments.scope: Pinned source code OpenResearch cargo build PASS and author compute tests 8/8; pinned original paper2project tree_hash executed; 5 seeds x5 source-derived git archive proxy pairs with deterministic content oracle, 5/5 metadata/dirty/commit/corrupt/persisted archive and independent missing full text negative controls.
experiments.limitations: Actual Rust SourceSnapshot::create, SQLite/daemon, agent/model backend, network, arbitrary code execution, real full-text paper checks and project integration NOT tested. A/B has intentionally different contract and tiny fixtures; speed is descriptive only.

experiments.scope: 5 permutations of 52 in-memory fixture tasks across 12 descriptions, 3 policies: static 260/260 1,085,775 chars, ideal oracle 260/260 538,875 chars, keyword 220/260 532,305 chars (40 misses; 20 negative cases). 4-role sequential ZCode council actually invoked bounded tools, 3 initial members valid, first chair failed budget, corrected chair independently audited and issued no-production verdict; GPT-6 precommitted analysis caught negative preview count error.
experiments.limitations: Only char-size synthetic proxy, gold oracle unrealistic, 52 repeated templates not independent; model calls confined to research deliberation and sandbox tools, not model tool-choice evaluation; 4 roles share one provider model; no metered GPT-6 reasoning cost, no fair council efficiency comparison; failed protocol and truncated tool summary. No production permission or code changes.

experiments.scope: 30 synthetic cases across three abstract domains x9 output patterns =270; compared document ACL, structured claim/provenance gate and deterministic output-bound gate. Oracle labels 90 ALLOW, 120 DENY, 60 INCONCLUSIVE; independent checker PASS 270/270. Output-bound gate: zero false disclosure releases, zero unverified releases, 90/90 safe outputs released, 120 INCONCLUSIVE.
experiments.limitations: No LLM, Hermes, Pi, retrieval, target project source, network, real records or production. Oracle uses exact synthetic markers and fixture provenance, not general semantic claim extraction. Output-bound renderer is a proposed contract, not an implementation. Author benchmark results NOT_REPRODUCED.

assessments.source_excerpt: Практический предметный fit: **проверка соединений, отказов, RTT handshake и коротких request-response TCP операций между тестовыми хостами**, потенциально при RCA симптомов PG replication/backup, клиентских disconnect и сетевых bottlenecks. `fireperf` — **активный генератор** и способен создать ненормальную нагрузку, даже если одна операция не использует значимый bandwidth.
